question: What claim is made about this practice of the soul having been told to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: A practice of the soul is referred to as this.
That practice has been told to the addressed person.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
